# R/W Book Club — Reading History

> This file is designed for LLM consumption. Paste this URL into any AI chatbot to give it full context about our book club's reading history. Human-readable site: https://rwbookclub.com

The R/W Book Club has been meeting since April 2003. The "R/W"
stands for Read / Write — the members are technically minded and many blog.
The club reads about 8 books per year, mostly non-fiction (~88%). Members
rotate picking the next book and hosting the discussion.

As of this build there are 182 books across
24 years of reading.

Meeting cadence:

- Meets roughly monthly (about 8 meetings per year)
- Members rotate picking the next book
- The picker usually hosts the discussion
- Meetings are in-person in the Minneapolis–Saint Paul area

Topic distribution:

- History & Economics: 27 books
- Science Fiction & Fiction: 25 books
- Politics & Social Sciences: 25 books
- Brain & Psychology: 24 books
- Science and Math: 23 books
- Technology: 22 books
- Current Events & People: 12 books
- Essays & Literature: 7 books
- Health & Medicine: 6 books
- Travel & Memoir: 5 books
- Philosophy & Religion: 3 books

The reading history at the end lists every book newest first, one section per
year. Each entry links the .txt file with the full metadata, synopsis, and
reviews for that book.

## How to use this archive

- [llms.txt](https://rwbookclub.com/llms.txt): this file. A compact index of every book, each linked to the detailed text file for that book.
- [Books](https://rwbookclub.com/books/): one plain-text file per book, `https://rwbookclub.com/books/<slug>.txt`, with full metadata, subjects (thematic tags), synopsis, meeting notes, member reviews, and a list of related books. Every book below links its own; fetch the one you care about.
- [Oliver](https://rwbookclub.com/oliver/): about Oliver, the club's AI agent (it maintains this archive)
- [books.json](https://rwbookclub.com/books.json): structured JSON, one row per book (including subjects and a related-books graph), for analytical or cross-book queries.
- [Authors](https://rwbookclub.com/authors/): a page per author, `https://rwbookclub.com/authors/<slug>/`, with a short bio and the books of theirs the club has read.
- [Meetings](https://rwbookclub.com/meetings/): the full meeting timeline (book discussions plus the occasional spouses' dinner, movie night, and book-picking session).
